description: The MAKO FULL SUSPENSION Off Road Recumbent handcycle is the ultimate, capable, rear wheel drive recumbent handcycle with suspension at all three wheels. Traction and hill climbing with a rear wheel drive recumbent handcycle are second to none. The Mako was developed for riders not able to or not interested in riding in the prone position (kneeling, face down) and for rider’s wanting more suspension control then the NUKE. The MAKO front suspension provides improved ride quality and downhill speed control. The 24” front wheels provide fantastic ground clearance while allowing for tighter turning radius. The 27.5×2.8″ rear tire provide superior traction and smooth ride.

components.description: Front Tektro HD-E745 "Twin" hydraulic disc brakes w/left side parking brake and 203mm disc rotors
Rear Tektro HD-E740 hydraulic disc brake with 180mm disk rotor
Rohloff Speedhub IGH with 14 speeds and 526% gear range
The Rohloff is an Internal Geared Hub (IGH) so you do NOT need to be pedaling while shifting and it requires very little maintenance
Front and Rear Suspension with Fox Float Shocks
ADI Active Contour 13" tall seatback (available in 15" or 16" wide)
Standard drive train complete with single speed crankset, Rohloff Speedhub (14-speed internal geared hub)
Fox Float Shocks with lockout and rebound features standard
Durable powder coating with many colors to choose from
The Mako can be steered with either the primary crankset or with the handlebars or a combination of both
Optional Bafang BBSO2 or CYC Photon 750W mid-drive motor located at jackshaft locations (under the seat).
Carbon fiber/fiberglass hybrid seat pan. 16″ and 18″ seat pan widths available.
Carbon fiber/fiberglass hybrid seat pan has 3″ of fore and aft adjustment to accommodate virtually any height of rider.
ADI Active Contour seat back available is 15″ and 16″ widths
Both seat pan and ADI seat back come with:
Carbon Fiber/ fiberglass hybrid foot trays adjust horizontally 6” and can be adjusted 3.5” vertically with the addition of more holes
Standard FRONT wheelset includes 24" Velocity Blunt 35 FRONT rims, 20mm Velocity hubs with Maxxis Minion DHF tires
Standard REAR wheel includes 27.5" Velocity Blunt 35 rim, Rohloff Speedhub 14-speed IGH hub with Maxxis Minion DHR tire
